title: Deletion Discipline: understand fully before you delete anything

intelligence.essence: No one deletes anything until they fully understand what it is, what purpose it serves, and whether it's important. If it's important, you don't delete it. Optimization is never a license to remove what you don't understand — "cleaning up duplicates" without understanding the objects is how ratified laws get destroyed. A naming collision is a naming defect, not a deletion permit. When in doubt, you ask the lanes, you don't delete.
